name: Bliss Up - Exploring Energy The Ultimate Healer
original_name: Bliss Up - Exploring Energy The Ultimate Healer
overview: A 5-part Docuseries - Discover the new paradigm of healing. Energy The Ultimate Healer Discover cutting-edge science that supports Energy healing/Medicine. It is one of the most direct forms of treatment for various diseases and the most ancient form of healing, and it has been used across various cultures globally for centuries. Follow five people as they work to heal themselves using energy healing/medicine. The series explores the process using the latest scientific methods.
